Intersection Alt Code and Symbol

The Alt code for Intersection is 239. Hold Alt, type 239 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt. Intersection also has the Unicode codepoint U+2229, so you can type it with Alt+8745 on Windows, search for U+2229 in macOS's Character Viewer, use ∩ in HTML, or \2229 in CSS. If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly — the Alt key method requires a physical numpad. Copy the Intersection character from this page when you need it in a form, chat message or document that does not accept Alt codes. HTML also defines the named entity ∩ for Intersection, but the numeric form ∩ is safer when compatibility is uncertain.

How to type intersection on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 2 3 9 on the numeric keypad.
  4. Release Alt. The Intersection character (∩) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type intersection on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for Intersection. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "Intersection" and click the character to insert it.

How to use intersection in code

  • HTML: or , also
  • CSS: content:"\2229"; ()
  • Python: \u2229 or chr(0x2229)
  • JavaScript: \u2229 or String.fromCodePoint(0x2229)
  • JSON: "\u2229"
  • LaTeX: $\cap$ (math mode)

Frequently asked questions

What is the Alt code for Intersection?

The legacy Alt code for Intersection is 239. Hold Alt, type 2 3 9 on the numeric keypad, then release Alt.

How do I type ∩ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ∩, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+8745 not work?

Alt+8745 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for Intersection?

The Unicode codepoint for Intersection is U+2229. You can use this value in HTML as ∩, in CSS as \2229, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ∩ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+2229, then click it.
